new_packages.label: הֲלָכוֹת וְנַחֲלַת אָבוֹת
new_packages.justification: Five concepts sharing a single essential nature: Torah-transmission as sacred patrimony and cosmic righteousness. (1) הֲלָכוֹת = נַחֲלַת אָבוֹת is an explicit identity statement ('הֵם'). (2) מַצְדִּיקֵי הָרַבִּים = מְלַמְּדֵי תִּינוֹקוֹת = כַּכּוֹכָבִים is declared via 'אֵלּוּ'. All five describe the same reality from different angles: halakhot as Israel's cosmic inheritance, and the teacher who gives it as a star illuminating many. This is an independent thematic domain — it is not covered by any existing package in the cross-Torah dataset because: (a) the concept of Torah-as-morasha/inheritance is specific to this Torah's argument, (b) the teacher-as-star bechina is unique to this Torah, and (c) the halakhot-node is used here in a legal-patrimonial sense distinct from the Torah-as-chokhmah packages in other Torahs.
source_quotes: כְּאִלּוּ גּוֹזְלוֹ מִנַּחֲלַת אָבוֹת, שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר: תּוֹרָה צִוָּה לָנוּ מֹשֶׁה מוֹרָשָׁה
וּמַצְדִּיקֵי הָרַבִּים כַּכּוֹכָבִים – אֵלּוּ מְלַמְּדֵי תִּינוֹקוֹת

new_packages.label: תַּרְבּוּת אֲנָשִׁים חַטָּאִים
new_packages.label_en: Brood of Sinful Men — The Corrupt Teacher Domain
new_packages.justification: Five concepts sharing the essential nature of the corrupt Torah-teacher and his domain: withholding/stealing the sacred inheritance and thereby corrupting many. (1) תַּרְבּוּת אֲנָשִׁים חַטָּאִים = תַּלְמִידֵי גֻּבְרַיָּא חַיָּבַיָּא — Onkelos's targum is a bechina-declaration of the verse's essential meaning. (2) מְחַיְּבֵי הָרַבִּים = מְנִיאֵי לֵב בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל — two expressions of the same evil-teacher action. (3) גּוֹזֵל נַחֲלַת אָבוֹת = the essential identity of the withholding teacher. This is the exact evil mirror of Package 103-A: every node in 103-B is the negative counterpart of a node in 103-A (גּוֹזֵל ↔ נַחֲלַת אָבוֹת; מְחַיְּבֵי הָרַבִּים ↔ מַצְדִּיקֵי הָרַבִּים; תַּלְמִידֵי גֻּבְרַיָּא חַיָּבַיָּא ↔ מְלַמְּדֵי תִּינוֹקוֹת). This is an independent thematic domain not covered by any existing package in the cross-Torah dataset: the corrupt-teacher archetype in its Torah-withholding dimension is unique to this Torah's frame.
source_quotes: קָרָא לָהֶם: תַּרְבּוּת אֲנָשִׁים חַטָּאִים, וְתִרְגֵּם אוּנְקְלוֹס: תַּלְמִידֵי גֻּבְרַיָּא חַיָּבַיָּא
מִסְּתָמָא גַּם רַבָּם אֵינָם מַצְדִּיקֵי הָרַבִּים, אֶלָּא מְחַיְּבֵי הָרַבִּים
שֶׁרַבְּכֶם גָּזַל מִכֶּם הֲלָכוֹת, וְהֲלָכוֹת הֵם נַחֲלַת אָבוֹת

observations:
Torah #103 has zero edges in the torahData.js dataset (reference===103, type===bechina returns no results). The Torah is 6 lines and is a short aggadic/legal teaching from two Talmudic sources (Sanhedrin 91b and Bava Batra 8b), applied by the Rebbe to his generation's corrupt teachers.

The bechina structure is entirely ethical/relational: it does not use kabbalistic terminology (sefirot, body parts, letters, celestial bodies in a mystical sense), but rather uses the classic midrashic technique of identity-declaration ('אֵלּוּ', 'הֵם', Onkelos targum) to establish conceptual equivalences in the moral domain.

Two clear independent packages emerge, each with 5 nodes:
  Package 103-A (good): The righteous teacher domain — halakhot = inheritance = making-many-righteous = children's teacher = star
  Package 103-B (evil): The corrupt teacher domain — making-many-guilty = dissuading Israel = brood of sinners = disciples of wicked men = robber of inheritance

The good/evil mirror structure is perfect and explicit: the Rebbe himself draws the contrast using the same verbal structure (מַצְדִּיקֵי הָרַבִּים → מְחַיְּבֵי הָרַבִּים; נַחֲלַת אָבוֹת given → נַחֲלַת אָבוֹת stolen).

These two packages cannot be merged into a single cross-Torah 'Torah' or 'teacher' package from other Torahs because:
1. The Torah-as-morasha/inheritance frame is Torah #103-specific (other Torahs use Torah as chokhmah, as light, as medicine — not as nachalat avot)
2. The teacher-as-star bechina (matzdikey harabim = kokhavim = melamdey tinokot) is unique to this Torah
3. The corrupt-teacher condemnation using the Reuven/Gad episode is unique to this Torah's peshat

Verdict: NEW_PACKAGES_PROPOSED — two new packages (103-A and 103-B) should be created when Torah #103 is added to the dataset.
